sleeping_bag.name: Mythic Down Sleeping Bag 20F (-6C)
sleeping_bag.subtitle: current official Mythic Down Sleeping Bag (-6C/20F), normalized to regular
sleeping_bag.key_features: Regular row; 700 g total; 355 g of 900 FP European goose down; ISO 23537 tested; TILT-reflective liner; hydrophobic down finish; half zip technical mountain cut.
sleeping_bag.marketing_summary: Rab positions the current Mythic -6C as a laboratory-tested lightweight mountain bag built to deliver a serious warmth-to-weight ratio with premium fabrics and reflective TILT technology.
sleeping_bag.manufacturer_claims: Excellent warmth-to-weight with ISO-tested protection, hydrophobic down and low-mass technical materials.
sleeping_bag.use_cases: Fast mountain missions, cold backpacking and alpinism where tested warmth matters.
sleeping_bag.source_notes: Verified 2026-05-17. User label 'Rab Mythic 20F' maps to the current official Mythic Down Sleeping Bag (-6C/20F). Do not collapse it into the older Mythic 400 page. Official FR price verified from Rab EU-FR; status was out of stock at the moment of verification.
sleeping_bag.current_status: current official product; out of stock on official FR site at verification time
sleeping_bag.comparison_notes: Current official naming has shifted from older Mythic 400 conventions to a direct temperature-led Mythic Down Sleeping Bag naming.
sleeping_bag.official_price_text: Official US price US$625.00; official FR price 700.00 EUR.
